claims.question: Rahu in 5th OR 9th versus Rahu conjoined with lords of both fifth and ninth

witnesses.name: R. Santhanam, vol I, p.168
witnesses.interpretation: Venus fifth; Rahu in either fifth or ninth

witnesses.name: Enjoy Learning Sanskrit
witnesses.interpretation: Venus fifth; fifth and ninth lords with Rahu

claims.source_critical_conclusion: The second reading adds implicit house lords absent as explicit īśa/nātha in the visible verse; the first is a translator's specific inference, not dictated solely by grammar. These have genuinely different chart antecedents.
